author: Samsung
description:
Some collections preserve more than art; they preserve a nation's history. The Lee Kun-Hee Collection, made up of more than 23,000 artworks given by the family of late Samsung Chairman Lee Kun-Hee to the Korean people, spans millennia and highlights the deep connections between Korea's artistic heritage and modern Korean culture. The remarkable story of this collection is told here by @HISTORY in partnership with Samsung.

Experience the collection at the British Museum in London beginning October 1. 
#Samsung
title: Korean National Treasures: Art and Tech
